declared_space.rule: (rows_file, arm, checkpoint_id, rep): rows_file ranges over rows-longrun-*.jsonl in the rows dir whose rows carry the fixture task_id; arm is DECLARED OUTSIDE THE ROWS — by the run manifest that produced the file (manifests/<run>.json: arm + rows_path), falling back to the runner's ARMS registry when no manifest declares the file; a name found in neither is `extraneous_cell`, never a discovery.  checkpoint_id is every id the FIXTURE declares (cp.<i>.t<turn>) plus the declared repair turn; rep is the single rep the fixture's run contract declares.

arm_registry.why_authoritative: run_longrun.py is the only cell driver: its ARMS tuple at line 64 names every arm it will build, and its per-arm builder raises ValueError('unknown arm ...') at line 862 for any other name, so an arm absent from this tuple cannot have been run honestly.

run_manifests.why_authoritative: each manifest is written before its run and pairs `arm` with `rows_path`, so it declares which arm may appear in which rows file without consulting the rows.

declared_space.formula: 23 run/arm pairs x 4 checkpoint ids x 1 rep = 92 cells
